requirements.statement: Provide precise content-free diagnostic reasons and safe relative locations while preserving issue codes.
acceptance: Missing, empty, over-limit and malformed input produce distinct fixed reasons.
Reports do not contain source contents, exception messages or absolute paths.

requirements.statement: Retain valid feature summaries and suggest the next explicit SDD action without executing or approving it.
acceptance: A broken feature does not hide valid summaries and still fails overall validation.
State/task counts and recommendations match declared states without claiming semantic approval.

requirements.statement: Bound enumeration and derive status from validated data with Windows/Linux and Node support checks.
acceptance: More than 100 entries fails before feature processing.
The supported-platform test matrix retains existing security controls.

decisions.summary: Use bounded single-pass inspection, additive fixed diagnostics and non-executing next-step guidance; broaden only the public CI test matrix.

tasks.summary: Add diagnostic reasons and bounded single-pass inspection.
Add valid-feature summaries, counts and next-step suggestions.
Verify behavior, platform matrix, documentation and isolated plugin installation.

checks.summary: Run actionable-status behavior regressions; platform and installation evidence is recorded in verification.md.
